environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instances in an isolated private subnet (no IGW, no NAT gateway route for inbound). Fronted by an internal Network Load Balancer (scheme: internal). The NLB is registered as a VPC Endpoint Service (AWS PrivateLink). Consumers connect exclusively through interface VPC endpoints (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f). The endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled, meaning only pre-approved AWS accounts (maintained in an allow-list) can create interface endpoints. The private subnet route table has NO route to an internet gateway or NAT gateway. Security group on the NLB target allows inbound only from the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16). DNS is configured with a private hosted zone only (no public DNS resolution). There is no public IP assigned to any instance. Additionally, VPC flow logs confirm no ingress from public IP ranges.

config.deployment: AWS EC2 in isolated private subnet (no IGW, no NAT for inbound)
config.internet_gateway: not attached to subnet route table
config.dns: private hosted zone only, no public records
config.route_table: local VPC routes only, no 0.0.0.0/0 route
